routes.task: Clips of one kelompok differ in colour / grade
routes.use: `python3 -m tools.vidkit colormatch CLIPS...` (report; add `--apply OUTDIR` only after the owner looked at `vidkit sheet`; `vidkit.colormatch.plan/apply`)

routes.task: Beat times of a music file
Land SFX cues on the music beat
routes.use: `python3 tools/sfx_snap.py <project> --music-plan work/music-plan.json` (or `--music FILE`; exit 2 bad input, 3 no beats; writes `work/sfx-plan.snapped.json`; `snap` = `vidkit.beats.snap`)

routes.task: Skip an expensive step when its inputs did not change
routes.use: `vidkit.stages.fingerprint(files, params, version)` + `StageCache(path).is_fresh/record`. `tools/edit_render.py` already uses it: a re-run skips unchanged segments (`--no-cache` forces a full render)
